_scoring.recall_note: blind items matched approximated by stored real records (correct+wrong); no stored correct record was outside the blind lists

_classes.name: list items under a powers lead-in ("powers shall include ... the following") stored as duties
_classes.rule: duty records whose quote matches ^\s*(\(\d+\)\s*)?to [a-z] (infinitive list item)

_classes.name: agency Unspecified although actor_raw names a body (land bank board, foreclosing governmental unit)
_classes.rule: agency=='Unspecified' and actor_raw non-empty and actor_raw !~ /passive|amount|monies|payment|sum/i

_classes.name: junk agency copied from actor_raw (passive subject or descriptive phrase) and used by <=3 records DB-wide
_classes.rule: agency used by <=3 records DB-wide AND agency == actor_raw after stripping leading article (case-insensitive); review list

_classes.name: sunset_shortened gate drops extensions where the deleted date is relative ("[thirty-nine years from] 1977", "[three years from] ... [thirteen]")
_classes.rule: dropped rule=='sunset_shortened' AND the law text near the quote has a bracketed deletion containing 'years from' (relative date the gate cannot compare); full count = all sunset_shortened drops, each needs a date compare

_classes.name: duplicate_provision gate drops a distinct parallel provision with near-identical wording (received vs disposition inventory)
_classes.rule: dropped rule=='duplicate_provision' whose word set differs from the kept record it 'overlaps' (any differing word; review for different object nouns)

_classes.name: prohibitions/limits ("No person may", "In no case may ... extend") stored as powers
_classes.rule: power records whose quote has 'No X may|may not|In no case may|shall not' and no other permissive 'may'

_classes.name: identical records (same law, quote, actor_raw, agency, unit, kind): per-actor split that never names the actor
_classes.rule: group by (matter_id, quote, lower(actor_raw), agency, agency_unit, kind); count records beyond the first in each group

_classes.name: (known class, recurrence count) dated recurring deadline stored as none
_classes.rule: duty, deadline_kind none, recurrence annual, quote names a quarter or day of each year

_classes.name: (known class, recurrence count) entitlement stored as duty; terminology-only reprint stored as duty

2021-S2209-02.quote: The office shall also develop guidelines for the operation of alcohol and substance use disorder treatment programs in such correctional facilities, based on best practices, and tailored to the nature of the individual's substance use, history of past treatment, and history of mental illness or trauma, which may include harm reduction strategies,

2009-A41011-02.quote: Reductions under this section shall commence on September 16, 2010 and be made in accordance with a written allocation plan prepared by the director of the budget, which shall be filed with the state comptroller, the chairman of the senate finance committee and the chairman of the assembly ways and means committee.

2009-A41011-04.quote: Upon request of the director of the budget, the comptroller shall transfer the cash equal to the uniform appropriation reduction to the fmap contingency fund established pursuant to section 99-r of the state finance law to the extent such cash is available.
